Rocket Lab Stock Breaks Above Key Trendline: Reports RKLB up 2.2% at $71.45 and crossing above its 50-day moving average, after prior rejections in July and August and a rebound from around $60. Attributes a historical comparison to Schaeffer analyst Rocky White: eight prior crossovers, with shares higher one month later in seven cases and a reported mean gain of 16.8%. Also reports SVI 70% and SVS 97/100. The article does not provide the underlying event list or calculation method. (time=2026-09-22 12:57 PM (page time; timezone not stated); cutoff=UNKNOWN).

This is media attribution, not proof of causality. (time=2026-09-22T11:52:23+05:30; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
